title: Error message sent on the text fallback endpoint

message.content: CBOR decoding failed. Fallback to text recommended.

expect.text: CBOR decoding failed. Fallback to text recommended.
expect.canonical_json: {"messagetype":"Error","format":"text","subformat":"English","content":"CBOR decoding failed. Fallback to text recommended."}

notes: The error indication is the MessageType value `Error` on a text message — not a `format` of `error`, which is not in Table 1 (see readings/03-format-error-not-a-format). This example is the standard's own support for that reading.
